| [FLOW-03 Inspect the documentation graph](flow-03-inspect-the-documentation-graph.feature) | As a documentation author inheriting a documentation set, I want to see every document, its freshness and how the documents point at each other, so that I can understand the shape of the set before changing anything. | 9 | @flow-03 @human-author @graph @mvp |
| [FLOW-04 Validate documents and graph integrity](flow-04-validate-documents-and-graph-integrity.feature) | As a documentation author responsible for a documentation set, I want one verdict per document plus a verdict on the set as a whole, so that I know exactly what breaks DEP compliance before I publish or merge. | 10 | @flow-04 @human-author @validation @mvp |
| [FLOW-05 Query documents by metadata](flow-05-query-documents-by-metadata.feature) | As an AI agent asked to work on part of a documentation set, I want to narrow the set down by type, audience, tag, confidence, freshness or owner, so that I load only the documents that matter to the task instead of the whole set. | 7 | @flow-05 @ai-agent @metadata @mvp |
| [FLOW-06 Find documents by keyword](flow-06-find-documents-by-keyword.feature) | As a documentation author looking for where a subject is already covered, I want to search the whole set by words and see why each document matched, so that I extend the right document instead of writing a duplicate. | 9 | @flow-06 @human-author @search @mvp |
| [FLOW-07 Build the semantic index](flow-07-build-the-semantic-index.feature) | As an AI agent that will search a documentation set by meaning, I want to build and incrementally refresh a semantic index of the set, so that meaning-based search is available without re-processing documents that have not changed. | 10 | @flow-07 @ai-agent @search @should |
| [FLOW-08 Search by meaning](flow-08-search-by-meaning.feature) | As an AI agent answering a question phrased in my own words, I want to find the documents that are about that question rather than the ones repeating my wording, so that I still find the right document when the set uses different vocabulary than the question. | 8 | @flow-08 @ai-agent @search @should |
| [FLOW-09 Trace what points at a document](flow-09-trace-what-points-at-a-document.feature) | As a documentation author about to change or retire a document, I want to see every document that points at it and how, so that I can judge the impact of my change before making it. | 6 | @flow-09 @human-author @graph @mvp |
| [FLOW-10 Explore a document's neighbourhood](flow-10-explore-a-document-s-neighbourhood.feature) | As an AI agent that has found one relevant document, I want to walk outwards from it a controlled number of hops along the relationships I care about, so that I load its surrounding context without loading the entire documentation set. | 8 | @flow-10 @ai-agent @graph @should |
| [FLOW-11 Follow an audience learning path](flow-11-follow-an-audience-learning-path.feature) | As a project lead onboarding into a new role, I want an ordered reading path that starts at my role's entry point and only includes what is meant for me, so that I learn the system in the order its authors intended. | 8 | @flow-11 @project-lead @navigation @should |
| [FLOW-12 Read prerequisites in order](flow-12-read-prerequisites-in-order.feature) | As a reader facing an advanced document, I want the chain of documents I should read first, in order, so that I am not blocked by concepts the document assumes I already know. | 8 | @flow-12 @human-author @navigation @should |
| [FLOW-13 Change a document's metadata](flow-13-change-a-document-s-metadata.feature) | As a documentation author maintaining a document, I want to change its declared metadata through the toolchain rather than by hand, so that invalid values are refused before they reach the file and the file's shape stays intact. | 12 | @flow-13 @human-author @metadata @mvp |
| [FLOW-14 Re-verify documents in bulk](flow-14-re-verify-documents-in-bulk.feature) | As a documentation author who has just reviewed a batch of documents, I want to record that they were verified today, one by one or by the whole batch, so that freshness reflects the review I actually did without editing each file by hand. | 10 | @flow-14 @human-author @lifecycle @mvp |
| [FLOW-15 Curate a document's tags](flow-15-curate-a-document-s-tags.feature) | As a documentation author organising a growing set, I want to add and remove tags on a document in one request, so that the set stays searchable by subject without me editing metadata by hand. | 10 | @flow-15 @human-author @metadata @should |
| [FLOW-16 Declare how documents relate](flow-16-declare-how-documents-relate.feature) | As a documentation author connecting a new document to the set, I want to declare, retype and remove typed relationships between documents, so that the graph stays navigable and only the six canonical relationships are used. | 13 | @flow-16 @human-author @graph @mvp |
| [FLOW-17 Regenerate the index documents](flow-17-regenerate-the-index-documents.feature) | As a documentation generator maintaining a set, I want index documents to be produced from the set's own metadata, so that readers always have an up-to-date way in and nobody maintains link lists by hand. | 10 | @flow-17 @ai-generator @indexing @should |
| [FLOW-18 Resolve a request to a decision tree](flow-18-resolve-a-request-to-a-decision-tree.feature) | As an AI agent receiving a request in the user's own words, I want to find out whether a decision tree already covers that request and how strong the match is, so that I follow the project's own procedure instead of improvising one. | 8 | @flow-18 @ai-agent @dap @mvp |
| [FLOW-19 Traverse a decision tree one node at a time](flow-19-traverse-a-decision-tree-one-node-at-a-time.feature) | As an AI agent following a project's procedure, I want to be handed one decision node at a time with only what that node needs, so that I act on the project's actual logic without loading the whole procedure into context. | 9 | @flow-19 @ai-agent @dap @mvp |
| [FLOW-20 Visualise a decision tree](flow-20-visualise-a-decision-tree.feature) | As an author reviewing a project's procedures, I want to see a whole decision tree at once, and the list of routes through it, so that I can judge whether the procedure is complete before an agent follows it. | 7 | @flow-20 @human-author @dap @should |
| [FLOW-21 Validate the decision trees](flow-21-validate-the-decision-trees.feature) | As an author who owns a project's procedures, I want each tree checked for reachability, complete branching, and a defined ending on every route, so that an agent following a tree can never fall off the end of it. | 10 | @flow-21 @human-author @dap @mvp |
| [FLOW-22 See how the procedures hand off to each other](flow-22-see-how-the-procedures-hand-off-to-each-other.feature) | As an author reviewing a project's procedures as a whole, I want to see every tree, its size and freshness, and which trees hand off to which, so that I can spot procedures that are unreachable, oversized or circular. | 5 | @flow-22 @human-author @dap @could |
| [FLOW-23 Work with DEP through the agent skills](flow-23-work-with-dep-through-the-agent-skills.feature) | As an AI agent installed in a project as the DEP plugin, I want validation, generation, auditing and syncing offered as named capabilities that run the project's own procedures, so that a user gets the project's documented behaviour without describing the protocol to me first. | 10 | @flow-23 @ai-agent @plugin @should |
